summary: MoveActive is a Melbourne Pilates and wellness accessories brand founded in 2009, with 7,500+ wholesale stockists and a UK launch in July 2026. Founder Melissa Pain leads; Mandy Drake is listed as CFO on a directory.

claims.text: MoveActive was founded in Melbourne in 2009 and sells Pilates and wellness accessories, best known for grip socks.
claims.quote: Founded in Melbourne in 2009, MoveActive creates stylish, performance-led accessories designed for Pilates, yoga, and everyday movement.

claims.text: MoveActive is headquartered in Brunswick East, with founder Melissa Pain listed as current owner/founder.
The Org lists Mandy Drake as Chief Financial Officer at MoveActive (unverified directory listing).
MoveActive launched in the UK in July 2026.
claims.quote: Premium Pilates and wellness accessories brand MoveActive is launching in the UK.

claims.text: MoveActive says its footprint spans more than 7,500 wholesale stockists globally across Australia, New Zealand, USA, UK and beyond.
claims.quote: MoveActive's footprint spans more than 7,500 wholesale stockists globally

claims.text: MoveActive says it uses organic cotton, recycled polyester and other recycled materials, with a range from grip socks to mats.
claims.quote: We are sustainably driven; using organic cotton, recycled polyester and other recycled materials

claims.text: SmartCompany's Smart50 2024 listed MoveActive with 52% growth and 24 employees.
claims.quote: Revenue: $6.5 million Growth: 52% Founder: Melissa Pain Head office: Brunswick, VIC Year founded: 2009 Employees: 24

claims.text: Melissa Pain's LinkedIn says she expanded the brand to over 7,500 stockists globally.
claims.quote: Expanded the brand's reach to over 7,500 stockist's globally, driving rapid growth and brand recognition.

hooks.text: UK launch in July 2026 on top of 7,500+ wholesale stockists across AU/NZ/US/UK implies multi-currency wholesale receipts to reconcile
Fast growth (52% in the Smart50 listing) with a small team

risks.text: Mandy Drake's CFO role rests on one unverified directory listing; no recent post from her found

gaps: No posts or interviews from Mandy Drake found
